pages.text: Press $(k:puffish_skills.open) and start planning your tree: six skill trees, 40 levels each, and 75 points to earn.

$(bold)Opening:$() $(k:puffish_skills.open). The skill menu shows all six trees and how your points are spent.$(br2)$(bold)Point sources:$() You earn points by completing Heracles quests ($(k:heracles.open_quests)). XP never buys points; that is deliberate, so points cannot be farmed.

$(bold)Respec:$() Each refunded point costs 5 XP levels. A full respec of 75 points costs 375 levels, expensive but possible at endgame. Respeccing a single tree costs less.$(br2)$(bold)Next: browse the six trees in $(l:icraft:skills/skills_overview)the skill tree overview$(/l) before you spend your first point.$()
